settings.heading: Smooth Your Wrinkles While You Sleep
settings.body: Soft, reusable silicone patches that hold your skin smooth and seal in moisture overnight — no needles, no tape, no refills. Peel them off in the morning to visibly smoother-looking skin.

settings.title: Apply before bed
settings.text: Smooth the patch onto clean, dry skin — from the center outward. It takes about 30 seconds.

settings.title: Sleep
settings.text: The soft silicone holds your skin smooth through the night and seals in your skin's own moisture. No actives — nothing absorbed.

settings.title: Peel and glow

settings.heading: Hold + hydrate, while you sleep
settings.text: While you sleep, your skin folds and loses moisture. The patch holds the skin surface smooth and seals in moisture — so lines look softer and "ironed out" by morning.

settings.question: Will the patches stay on all night?
settings.answer: Applied to clean, fully dry skin — no serum or oil underneath — the patch is made to stay in place overnight. Smooth it from the center outward so it sits flat.

settings.question: How many times can I reuse them?
settings.answer: Many nights with proper care: clean the patch after each use and store it on its backing.

settings.question: Are they safe under my eyes?
settings.answer: The eye patches are shaped for the delicate under-eye area. Apply without stretching the skin, and stop if you feel irritation.

settings.question: Is there a subscription?
settings.answer: No. You buy once and reuse. No refills, no memberships, nothing recurring — for the patches or the cap.
